messages:
Maya: Quick sync — partner PM wants the marketplace microsite content freeze by EOD Tue. Who owns final QA for partner badges + integration links? Also need cloud marketplace SKU mapping for billing.
Kevin: I can take badge QA. Need high-res PNGs + approved partner logos. Can someone drop the assets to the shared drive? :+1:
Olivia: Raj (SI PM) already uploaded drafts: https://drive.example.com/si-assets — noticed SKU mismatch between the spreadsheet and the marketplace manifest.
Sam: I’ll own SKU mapping. Can you paste the current CSV snippet here? If easier I can pull from the manifest.
Olivia:
```
sku,product_name,partner_id
RW-DA-001,Redwood Accelerated Serving,partner-volt
RW-EMB-10,Redwood Embeddings Pro,partner-volt
```
Sam: Thanks — that matches our table except partner-volt should be partner-volt-hw for the hardware SKU.
Kevin: Badge QA checklist (short): 1) right logo + spacing 2) accessible alt text 3) 300dpi PNG + SVG fallback 4) color profile sRGB. I’ll run through and post screenshots.
press-team: Embargo window being requested Wed 09:00 PT. We need a partner-approved quote and final headline by EOD Tue. Legal requires partner legal sign-off on the quote.
raj: I’ll schedule SI integration validation on Tue 11:00 PT. Need a test tenant + API key from the partner and the manifest they’ll publish.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging cutover scheduled 02:00 UTC Wed. Runbook: https://runbooks.example.com/microstore-cutover — runbook steps:
```
1) Snapshot current staging
2) Deploy microsite v1.4
3) Smoke test partner flows
4) Switch DNS to canary
```
Olivia: I can lead the rehearsal Thurs 03:00 PT. Would like @kevin & @sam in the run-through.
Maya: Ownership recap — badge QA -> @Kevin; SKU mapping -> @Sam; press quote -> @press-team; rehearsal -> @Olivia; SI tests -> @raj. I’ll compile checklist and send a single message to partner PM. :sparkles:
Kevin: Will post badge screenshots by EOD Mon.
Sam: I’ll update the SKU CSV and push to the manifest repo; ping when it’s done.
Maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop here or ping me directly.
